blocks.text: The first row of transition elements runs from titanium to copper. Their common physical and chemical properties arise from their partly filled 3d orbitals.

items: Physical: hard, dense, high-melting metals that conduct well (18.2.1).
Chemical: variable oxidation states, complex ions, coloured compounds and catalytic activity (18.2.2 to 18.2.4).

blocks.prompt: Which electrons are responsible for the special properties of the 3d elements?
blocks.explanation: The electrons in the partly filled 3d subshell.

items: Properties of Ti to Cu come from partly filled 3d orbitals.
